responsibility: Implements Punycode encoding for the Rust frontend’s Unicode identifier and name-handling support. The file contains the RFC 3492 bias adaptation and variable-length digit encoding algorithm, consumes Utf8String/Codepoint sequences, returns an ASCII-only encoded string via tl::optional on overflow or success, and includes selftests with known examples, making it the module’s executable conversion logic rather than just the interface.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the rust-punycode pair: it contains the RFC 3492 encoding algorithm itself, including bias adaptation, digit encoding, overflow checks, and selftests, whereas rust-punycode.h only exposes encode_punycode and the test entry point.
